source_question: Which Ontology or Schema does this implementation bind?
source_effect: Records an implementation-model binding without proving conformance or runtime behavior.

independent_meaning.state_parameter: W: independently defined typed semantic world and owned catalogs
common_constraints: Exact kind/source definition and approved meaning revision.
Exact source/target node kinds and revisions match one declared ordered pair.
Every required qualifier has its independently defined typed interpretation; closed qualifier object has no extra field.
Primary witness, subject, target, context, scope, source snapshot, epoch and time domain agree with the complete frame.
The selected evidence and provenance policy establishes the claimed recorded/as-of/executed/observed posture; missing authenticity is not manufactured.
kind_specific_constraints: w.implementation = s and w.model = t; the exact binding role identifies schema or ontology binding.
The model binding is independent of conformance assessments and runtime traces.

qualifiers.interpretation: schema-binding or ontology-binding role as determined by target kind
qualifiers.success_condition: Unique typed resolution under the exact frame; the resolved value equals its role in the independent witness and every meaning condition holds.
qualifiers.unresolved_result: unknown; ambiguous, wrong-kind or unsupported catalog entries cannot establish this meaning

operational_effect.meaning: Record implementation-to-model binding without executing the implementation or admitting either endpoint.
operational_effect.record_delta: Append one exact immutable witnessed relation record, or idempotently retain an identical existing revision; same revision with different content is refused.
operational_effect.recording_preservation: Recording a relation preserves authority roots, ownership, identity classes, admissions and runtime/external state. A separately authorized execution can change only its approved domain envelope.
operational_effect.execution_boundary: A record append does not implement its source witness's execution. Materialization requires evidence of a completed authorized atomic application; no standalone relation row proves it.

worked_failure: An ontology binding cannot silently substitute for a schema binding with different endpoints.
source_refinement_contract: Under exact owned catalog/frame well-formedness, decoding and resolution of raw source fields yields a iff the independently specified source constraints denote Meaning_K07(W,a). The decoder/checker must not define that source predicate.
proof_contract: Prove the independent meaning has a valid positive model.
Prove each exact qualifier mapping and checker/meaning equivalence.
Prove declared record effect and any required execution/closure preservation.
Check each kind-scoped non-entailment countermodel under the complete pinned theory.
Account for all declared ordered pairs and prove role-sensitive branches; one positive example per kind is insufficient.
approval_scope_note: The prior receipt, if present, retains its exact earlier scope. It does not accept this expanded batch revision, global policies or proofs.
formal_expression: Meaning_K07(W,e,f) := ∃ w ∈ W.ImplementationBinding. Base_K07(W,e,f,w) ∧ (w.implementation = s ∧ w.model = t ∧ w.role = code(q.binding_role) ∧ ((kind(t)=schema ∧ w.constructor=schemaBinding) ∨ (kind(t)=ontology ∧ w.constructor=ontologyBinding)))

notation.W: independently supplied typed semantic world, exact captured bodies and owner catalogs; not checker output
notation.e: candidate edge with kind, exact source s, exact target t and closed raw qualifiers q
notation.f: complete exact evaluation frame and selected meaning/evidence/digest/catalog profiles
notation.q: e.qualifiers; precisely the required fields listed below
notation.w: independent normalized primary witness record, with the following typed roles

witness_fields.constructor: schemaBinding or ontologyBinding with exact model reference

special_atoms.code: The unique entry in the owner-reviewed code catalog indexed by relation kind, exact ordered pair, field and catalog revision. Its semantic constructor and record role must agree; identical spellings in another catalog are distinct.
special_atoms.kind: The independently captured governed artifact kind of an exact reference. Camel-case constructor names in formulas denote the corresponding hyphenated source kinds listed in the signature matrix.

base_definition: Base requires exact selected kind/meaning revision; membership of this ordered pair in the pinned signature; independently captured endpoint revisions; exactly the declared qualifier fields with unique typed catalog interpretation; primary witness source/target joins and frame agreement; and provenance sufficient for the declared claim tier. It never invokes the relation checker. Undefined resolution cannot establish Meaning.

plain_language_intuition.text: An implementation declares a binding to an ontology or schema. Binding identifies what it implements, while conformance and performance are assessed separately.

operational_interpretation.meaning: Record implementation-to-model binding without executing the implementation or admitting either endpoint.
operational_interpretation.record_delta: Append one exact immutable witnessed relation record, or idempotently retain an identical existing revision; same revision with different content is refused.
operational_interpretation.recording_preservation: Recording a relation preserves authority roots, ownership, identity classes, admissions and runtime/external state. A separately authorized execution can change only its approved domain envelope.
operational_interpretation.execution_boundary: A record append does not implement its source witness's execution. Materialization requires evidence of a completed authorized atomic application; no standalone relation row proves it.
operational_interpretation.record_postcondition: R_after = R_before ∪ {exactRecord(e,w,f)} for a new row; identical retry leaves R unchanged; same record identity with different content refuses atomically.
operational_interpretation.meaning_world_preserved: W_after = W_before; appending the relation log alone does not execute its witness, change authority roots or replace active artifacts.
operational_interpretation.composed_closure_status: Full-rule/composed-state preservation remains a separate theorem target; append-only local behavior does not prove it.

worked_cases.positive: Implementation I binds Schema S while one conformance case still fails.
worked_cases.insufficient: An ontology binding cannot silently substitute for a schema binding with different endpoints.
worked_cases.correction: Use a schema-binding witness for a schema target and an ontology-binding witness for an ontology target.

source_refinement_gap: Source-to-model binding fields and owned role catalogs require refinement; a binding must not reuse conformance evidence as its definition.
